name: Meikko ga Ninshin Suru Made
original_name: 姪っ子が妊娠するまで
source:
One day, his niece, Amamiya Kotoha, suddenly appeared standing in front of his house. Her mother—his divorced older sister—had gotten involved with a new man and kicked her out of the house. So began his life living with his niece in the house left behind by his deceased parents.

“I love you so much, Uncle. I'm so happy we get to live together.”

Perhaps lonely without her parents, she clung to him constantly, always wanting to be together. They shared the same bath and slept in the same bed. 

He witnessed his niece masturbating while thinking of him, and unable to resist, he ended up having sex with her. Time passed, and after her first period, she begged him for a baby. Responding to her wish, they began making love to conceive a child.
translation:
有一天，他的侄女雨宫琴叶突然出现在他家门前。她的母亲——他离婚的姐姐——与一个新男人交往，并将她赶出了家门。就这样，他开始了与侄女住在已故父母留下的房子里的生活。

“我非常爱你，叔叔。我很高兴我们能住在一起。”

也许是因为没有父母的陪伴，她感到孤独，所以她总是紧紧地粘着他，总是想和他在一起。他们共用同一个浴室，睡在同一张床上。

他目睹侄女一边想着他一边手淫，他无法抗拒，最终与她发生了性关系。时间流逝，第一次月经过后，她向他求要一个孩子。为了满足她的愿望，他们开始做爱并怀孕生子。
